description: What an airline fare class (booking code) means and what it earns, from cwsi.net's fare charts. Give a fare letter (e.g. Delta K) or a Southwest fare name, or leave fare_class out to list them all. Covers Aegean Airlines, Aerolineas Argentinas, Aeromexico, Air Canada, Air China, Air Europa, Air France, Air India, Air New Zealand, Alaska, Allegiant, American, ANA, Avianca, Breeze, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, China Airlines, China Eastern, Copa Airlines, Croatia Airlines, Delta, Ethiopian Airlines, Etihad Airways, EVA Air, Finnair, Frontier, Hawaiian, Iberia, ITA Airways, Japan Airlines, JetBlue, KLM, Korean Air, LOT Polish Airlines, Lufthansa, Malaysia Airlines, Qantas, Qatar Airways, Royal Air Maroc, Royal Jordanian, SAS, Shenzhen Airlines, Singapore Airlines, South African Airways, Southwest, SriLankan Airlines, Sun Country, TAP Air Portugal, Thai Airways, Turkish Airlines, United, Vietnam Airlines, Virgin Atlantic and Xiamen Airlines.
